title: A cleaner iPhone roster and reliable staffing saves
summary: Refreshes the iPhone layout and gives leave and overtime a clear save result.
changes: Uses quieter light and dark colours, simpler segmented controls and a shorter bottom tab bar across the roster.
Keeps the compact title hidden until the in-page header has scrolled out of view.
Shows one confirmation status for a shared plan and groups People controls into a single list.
Keeps staffing entries during slow saves, retries a lost response once using the same operation ID and confirms successful saves independently of the roster refresh.
Opens Edit absence with the recorded nurse and reason already selected.
